summary: Completed backend + frontend integration regression for ecommerce flows using public URL. Backend APIs passed critical auth/catalog/cart/order/payment/account tests; frontend core auth/cart/COD/account flows work, but checkout UI has integration/UX mismatches.

ui_bugs.issue: Pay with Stripe button remains enabled even when cart is empty; click does not proceed and only shows toast path.

integration_issues.flow: Checkout totals vs backend order totals
integration_issues.issue: Frontend hardcodes discount=20 and computes tax/total client-side, but backend order API computes totals with discount=0 and different formula; customer-visible amount can diverge from charged amount.

In browser automation, Stripe redirect was not consistently observed despite backend /payments/checkout/session passing in pytest API tests; needs deterministic UI-level retest with visible cart state and network tracing.

action_items: Align CheckoutPage displayed subtotal/tax/discount/total with backend order-calculation response (single source of truth).
Disable Stripe/COD submit actions when cart.item_count === 0 and show explicit empty-cart CTA.
Re-validate frontend Stripe redirect path with deterministic preconditions and log /api/orders/checkout + /api/payments/checkout/session calls from UI.
critical_code_review_comments: CheckoutPage uses hardcoded discount and client-only amount math, creating high risk of payment mismatch with backend totals.
Order placement buttons are not guarded by empty-cart disabled state; avoid no-op submission UX.
seed_data_creation: Created test users via signup API and test orders/cart entries through authenticated API/UI flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite is reusable and green against public URL. For frontend, auth->cart->COD->account worked. Focus next retest on checkout Stripe click path with strict precondition (confirmed non-empty cart from UI) and verify redirect to Stripe URL from browser.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 Total mismatch: frontend computes display totals locally (fixed $20 discount) while backend order logic uses dynamic shipping/tax and no discount, leading to possible amount discrepancy. RCA-2 Checkout submit UX: submit buttons enabled even when cart empty, so click path returns early and appears non-functional. Stripe API itself is not MOCKED in this environment and backend endpoint tests passed.
